source_only_inventory.name: TevAlloc
source_only_inventory.finding: Allocates HSD_TETev-sized pooled storage and asserts nonnull.

source_only_inventory.name: CnstAlloc
source_only_inventory.finding: Allocates HSD_TECnst-sized pooled storage and asserts nonnull.

source_only_inventory.name: HSD_TExpFree
source_only_inventory.finding: Dispatches pooled free by actual TEV/constant type; other kinds including sentinels are no-ops. Does not release dependencies or external values.

source_only_inventory.name: IsThroughColor
source_only_inventory.finding: Recognizes ADD with A/B selectors zero, zero bias and unit scale; does not inspect C/D, clamp, type or null.

source_only_inventory.name: IsThroughAlpha
source_only_inventory.finding: Analogous alpha predicate; no C/D, clamp, type or null check.

source_only_data: Regular argument maps a_in/c_in C615-618, alpha in C665, color-konst xsel/csel C695-707, alpha-konst sel C770-779, destination dst C922-923, upload id1/id2 C1033-1035. Source-level roles are supported; emitted sections are not.
unresolved: Three compiled section layouts and their outgoing links.
No runtime verification of malformed graphs, allocation failures, reference overflow or undefined upload channels.
Foreign scheduling correctness not audited end to end; only supporting entry-point semantics inspected.

failures.error: Tuple item assignment TypeError before supplemental read
failures.resolution: Used mutable records and clamped receipt end lines to actual source length; rerun succeeded.
